title: Upgrade
description: Moves every plain version a central package file pins to the newest listed release across its NuGet sources, then restores its projects with dotnet restore --force-evaluate

central.description: Central package file (Directory.Packages.props) whose PackageVersion and GlobalPackageReference versions move

projects.description: Project files reading the central file, restored in one NuGet graph after the move

args.description: Arguments after -- appended to the restore
